content_sections.heading: CCRAS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies are available – 3 for Senior Research Fellow (Bio-Statistics), 1 for Senior Research Fellow (Public Health/Operational Research), 1 for Senior Consultant (Sanskrit), 1 for Senior Consultant (Ayurveda), 5 for Consultant (Ayurveda), 1 for Young Professional (Statistics), 2 for Young Professional (Graphic Designer), 1 for Consultant (Vigilance) (Retired), 1 for Consultant (Accounts) (Retired), and 1 for Office Assistant (Retired).

content_sections.heading: CCRAS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow (Bio-Statistics): Post Graduate degree in Statistics / Mathematics / Bio-Statistics with Statistics as one of the subject from a recognized University/Institution. Senior Research Fellow (Public Health/Operational Research): Bachelor's degree (BAMS/BUMS/BHMS/BSMS/BYNS) from recognized university along with a Master's Degree in Public Health Program/Post Graduate Diploma in Public Health Administrative OR Postgraduate in Operational Research from recognized university. Senior Consultant (Sanskrit): Acharya or equivalent post-graduate Degree in Sanskrit from recognized University with more than 10 years of work experience. Senior Consultant (Ayurveda): MD/MS (Ayurveda) from a recognized University with more than 10 years of work experience. Consultant (Ayurveda): MD/MS (Ayurveda) from a recognized University with minimum 05 years of work experience OR BAMS from a recognized University with minimum 07 years of work experience. Young Professional (Statistics): Graduate degree in Statistics / Mathematics / Bio-Statistics with Statistics as one of the subject from a recognized University/Institution. Young Professional (Graphic Designer): Bachelor Degree in Design. Consultant (Vigilance) (retired): Retired Section Officer/Under Secretary/Deputy Secretary or equivalent at pay level-08 to 12 from Govt. of India/State Government/ Attached and Subordinate Offices/ Autonomous bodies. Consultant (Accounts) (retired): Retired Section Officer/Under Secretary/Deputy Secretary or equivalent at pay level-08 to 12 from Govt. of India/State Government/ Attached and Subordinate Offices/ Autonomous bodies. Office Assistant (retired): Retired Assistant/A.S.O. or equivalent at pay level-6/7 from Govt. of India/State Government/ Attached and Subordinate Offices/ Autonomous bodies.

content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) is 35 years. Maximum age limit for Senior Consultant is 50 years. Maximum age limit for Young Professional is 45 years. Maximum age limit for retired Consultants and Office Assistant is 64 years.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CCRAS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CCRAS recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the CCRAS various posts is scheduled to be held on 06 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for CCRAS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies announced for various posts including Senior Research Fellow, Consultant, and Young Professional.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CCRAS recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Consultant (Ayurveda) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant (Ayurveda) post is Rs. 60,000/- per month consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. What are the required documents for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-In-Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the educational qualification for Young Professional (Statistics)?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Young Professional (Statistics) is a Graduate degree in Statistics / Mathematics / Bio-Statistics with Statistics as one of the subjects.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the CCRAS office in New Delhi, 110058.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for retired candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the maximum age limit for retired Consultants and Office Assistant is 64 years.
